unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
NOT_SERVER_MEMBER: You are not a member of this server. Ask for an invite or join from Explore if the server is public.
BANNED_FROM_SERVER: You are banned from this server and cannot use voice channels.
COMMUNICATION_TIMEOUT: You are in a communication timeout in this server and cannot join voice channels until it ends.
MISSING_VIEW_CHANNEL: You cannot use this voice channel: your roles do not include View Channel (the channel may be hidden or denied by an overwrite).
MISSING_CONNECT: You cannot join this voice channel: Connect is denied for your roles on this channel.
VOICE_CHANNEL_FULL: This voice channel is full (user limit reached). Ask an admin to raise the limit, or have a moderator move someone.
VOICE_CHANNEL_NOT_FOUND: No voice channel exists with this id on this server, or this channel is not a voice channel.
VOICE_E2EE_EPOCH_REQUIRED: Voice encryption setup failed. Try rejoining the channel.
VOICE_E2EE_ENVELOPE_MISSING: Voice encryption setup failed. Try rejoining the channel.
UPGRADE_REQUIRED: This account type can't join servers from the public Explore directory.
FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.
GUEST_EMAIL_LOCKED: Upgrade your guest account to set an email address.
GUEST_PHONE_LOCKED: Upgrade your guest account to add a phone number.
GUEST_USERNAME_LOCKED: Upgrade your guest account to change your username.
USERNAME_SHADOW_LOCKED: This account cannot change its username.
